description: Prepare single-DGX-Spark connectivity, staged configuration and acceptance evidence for spark-game.

deployment_geography.cloud_data: Planner traffic requires provider region and data-policy review.

requirements.tool_permissions: Operator-scoped access; no permissions granted to meeting agents.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Screenshot parameters mistaken for actual deployment values
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Collect SP-01 through SP-08; do not assume port, model or second machine.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Overwriting live configuration or exposing credentials
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Stage generated.env, use dry-run and empty bundle directories, inject secrets on target.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Local checks mistaken for successful deployment
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Record target checks as not_run until actual evidence is available.

ethical_considerations: No art integration or asset generation.
Do not transmit private meeting material without an agreed cloud-data boundary.
Do not fabricate benchmark, signature or human acceptance evidence.
